title: Session 5: Practical Tools for Defining Your Purpose
learning_objectives: Use practical tools and techniques to clearly define and articulate your life purpose. Create a personal purpose statement aligned with your values.
primary_content:
Session 5: Practical Tools for Defining Your Purpose (90 minutes)

💡 Key Takeaway

Learning Objective: Use practical tools and techniques to clearly define and articulate your life purpose.

📖 The Fisherman and the Merchant

A wealthy merchant found a fisherman resting by his boat. "Why aren't you fishing?" asked the merchant. "I caught enough for today," replied the fisherman. "But you could catch more, sell them, buy a bigger boat, hire workers, and become rich!" The fisherman asked, "Then what?" "Then you could relax and enjoy life," said the merchant. The fisherman smiled, "But I'm already doing that."

This story reminds us that purpose isn't always about accumulation—sometimes it's about recognizing what truly fulfills us.

🔑 Key Topics

Success Afrika Techniques for Purpose Discovery:

  • Passion identification exercises
  • Strengths assessment and mapping
  • Values clarification activities
  • Life experiences analysis

"Your purpose in life is to find your purpose and give your whole heart and soul to it"

— Buddha

Crafting Your Purpose Statement:

  • Elements of a powerful purpose statement
  • Aligning purpose with personal values
  • Making it specific and actionable
  • Testing for authenticity and resonance

🎯 Activity

Purpose Statement Workshop: Using the Success Afrika framework, complete the passion and strengths assessments. Then craft your first draft purpose statement in 2-3 sentences. Share with a peer for feedback and refinement.

🤔 Purpose Clarity Questions

  • What activities make you lose track of time?
  • What problems in the world do you feel called to solve?
  • How do you want to be remembered?
  • What unique combination of skills and passions do you possess?

quiz.title: Session 5 Knowledge Check
quiz.description: Test your understanding of key concepts from this session
quiz.instructions: Answer all true/false questions based on the session content. You have 3 attempts to achieve the passing score.

questions.question_text: The fisherman and merchant story teaches that true purpose is always about accumulating wealth.
questions.explanation: False. The story shows that true purpose isn't about riches but fulfillment - the fisherman was content with his simple life.

questions.question_text: Success Afrika techniques focus on identifying both passions and strengths when defining purpose.
questions.explanation: True. The session covers Success Afrika techniques for identifying passions and strengths as part of purpose definition.

questions.question_text: Your purpose statement should be aligned with your personal values.
questions.explanation: True. The session emphasizes aligning purpose with values as a key component of crafting a meaningful purpose statement.

questions.question_text: Peer feedback is discouraged when developing your purpose statement.
questions.explanation: False. The session activity specifically includes getting peer feedback on your first draft purpose statement.

questions.question_text: A well-crafted purpose statement should be written in the first draft and never revised.
questions.explanation: False. The session focuses on writing a 'first draft' of your purpose statement, implying it will be refined over time.
